title: 贝恩资本在华配置占比：从30%降到15%，为何今年仍投入10亿美元？
speaker: John Connaughton

segments.en: although we've had big exits in the US as well. Well, what's been sort of your exposure to China right now for a bit?
segments.zh: 尽管我们在美国也有大型退出项目。那么，你们目前在中国市场的敞口如何？

segments.en: It's moved down as a percentage. We're still committed.
segments.zh: 占比有所下降，但我们仍致力于中国市场。

segments.en: We have a big team in Shanghai as well as here in Hong Kong.
segments.zh: 我们在上海和香港都设有大型团队。

segments.en: We participate not just in private equity, but also hybrid capital.
segments.zh: 我们不仅参与私募股权，还参与混合资本。

segments.en: So, you know, we've probably put a billion dollars to work this year in China.
segments.zh: 所以，今年我们在中国市场投入了大约十亿美元。

segments.en: And it's been about 10% to 15% of our assets of deployment.
segments.zh: 这大约占我们资产配置的10%到15%。

segments.en: But it's come down, obviously, from where it used to be, which is 25 or 30%.
segments.zh: 但显然已从过去的25%或30%下降。

segments.en: What's your sense of what that number looks like then? So it's a billion this year.
segments.zh: 那么你对这个数字有何看法？今年是十亿美元。

segments.en: Is there a structural sort of headwind that you're trying to navigate there?
segments.zh: 是否存在结构性的不利因素需要应对？

segments.en: Or how are you looking at going down? No, I think it's a great question, and it changes all the time.
segments.zh: 或者你如何看待下降趋势？不，我认为这是个好问题，而且情况一直在变。
